notes.title: 04 May 2020 Patch notes
notes.notes:
Night vision grain reduced

Night made brighter

Small bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch notes 04 May 2020
notes.notes:
Patch notes 04 May 2020

Night is now shorter and brighter.

Zombie player detection got improved. Now you need to move or be close to a zombie for him to spot you even if he is looking at you.

Zombie sight has been decreased.

Small bug fixes

notes.title: Patch notes 03.05.2020
notes.notes:
Zombies now do 1/3 of the damage they used to.

Zombies now have to get closer to you to attack.

Weapon bug removed

Melee hit range increased

Added autorun

Added tips to the loading screen

Increased pickup range of items.

Loading time improved.

notes.title: Small bug fixes
notes.notes:
There will be a patch shortly with some bugs I found in the reviews of the game...

Campfire is now usable

While sprinting in first person and hitting A,D or S keys it will slow you down but if you still hold shift and release these keys you will sprint again.

Crosshair is now still visible on bows when you aim.

The patch will be live 03.05.2020 12:00 GMT+1/ CET

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes: There will be another small patch changing the way map works. You will now see and indicator on the map now instead of figuring out your position from the map coordinates. And the night will be brighter again.

notes.title: Small bug fixes
notes.notes:
There is a small patch coming this evening 18:00 GMT+1 CET

Changes

You can now respawn right after you die at the spawn nearest to your death. Or you can disconnect and then connect to a random location.

Shadow flickering on lower settings has been fixed.

Day/night cycle has been more optimized.

You no longer need to reach level 2 to enter the safezone.
